2026-09-06 repro-first intake is creating a story from accepted candidate evidence. Probe rp-mtprb2px-5y3pae and review rr-mtprf6qd-yx5112 are bound before development starts.
Classify and partition pure, quorum_prune, and integration cases without losing aggregate coverage

Correct and refactor the TypeScript quorum-submit integration suite in one Story: make selection exact and fail-closed, register every existing check without loss, classify pure checks, quorum_prune scenarios, and Git/CLI/lock/concurrency/signature/large-file integration cases into three or four isolated shards, reuse immutable fixture templates, and add truthful resource declarations plus bounded process parallelism. Preserve the compiled black-box contract, the four existing DYN-5 case identities and receipt semantics, and production quorum behavior; exclude Rust and unrelated validation-runner redesign. Before editing shared config or documentation and again before final same-host benchmarks, merge the latest local main after checking B-aa5f state and resolve only the file interaction without absorbing its receipt or freshness semantics.
Declare truthful resources and run independent quorum partitions concurrently
Make quorum-submit smoke selection complete, isolated, and safely parallel
Make targeted quorum smoke execution fail closed and independent
Make the full quorum smoke case inventory mechanically lossless

Probe rp-mtprb2px-5y3pae proves that an unmatched --grep reports PASS with zero checks, while isolated execution of a stateful check fails because its prerequisites live in earlier checks. Replace ambiguous zero-work narrowing with stable exact selection and explicit prerequisite setup. Persistent RED command before implementation: node packages/main/tests/red/red-B-e40f-quorum-submit-harness.mjs --case=selector-contract. The identical command and selector must become GREEN.
Reuse fixture templates without allowing state to leak between cases

The default command currently has 73 check call sites while the DYN-5 registry exposes only four special quorum scenarios. Establish unique stable identities and a bidirectional implementation-to-inventory guard so splitting cannot silently drop, duplicate, replace, or invent coverage. Preserve the four existing DYN-5 case IDs, runner markers, sentinel behavior, and receipt semantics. Persistent RED command before implementation: node packages/main/tests/red/red-B-e40f-quorum-submit-harness.mjs --case=inventory-bijection. The identical command and selector must become GREEN.
The maintainer sees a normal ProofOrStop story with a durable intake binding, then still expects DEV, REVIEW, TEST, validation, and DONE evidence to prove the actual fix after implementation.

The quorum validation row has no resources and therefore receives a plan-wide exclusive barrier. Only after runtime write tracing and fixture isolation prove the claims, declare the real repository reads and unique temporary writes and execute compatible shards through a bounded process pool without changing the general scheduler. Persistent correctness RED command before implementation: node packages/main/tests/red/red-B-e40f-quorum-submit-harness.mjs --case=resource-parallel-contract. The identical command and selector must become GREEN. Performance acceptance is frozen: on one idle host and one Node/toolchain version, after one build, run the baseline aggregate and the GREEN --jobs=1 and --jobs=2 variants three times each in alternating order; compare medians over complete identical case-ID sets. GREEN requires jobs=2 median wall time at least 20 percent below the recorded pre-change baseline and at least 15 percent below GREEN jobs=1, with identical verdicts, failure propagation, and zero residue. If either threshold is missed, do not claim or complete the performance optimization.

The repro review is red-reviewed and classified as target-bug, so this story starts from observed failing behavior instead of a speculative fix. Candidate quorum-submit-case-harness-20260906 remains intake evidence only.

The suite mixes cheap deterministic checks, 21 quorum_prune scenarios, and other real Git, CLI, lock, concurrent-write, environment, signature, and large-file integration cases. Classify every case by observed resource and isolation needs, then form three or four isolated DYN-5-compatible shards rather than treating every non-prune case as pure. Preserve a fail-closed default aggregate over the canonical inventory with a real end-to-end sentinel in every required domain. Persistent RED command before implementation: node packages/main/tests/red/red-B-e40f-quorum-submit-harness.mjs --case=partition-contract. The identical command and selector must become GREEN.

The suite repeatedly initializes temporary Git repositories and recreates equivalent commits. Build immutable templates by compatible fixture profile and give every case a unique derived fixture with deterministic cleanup; never share mutable refs, events, caches, locks, or Story files. Persistent RED command before implementation: node packages/main/tests/red/red-B-e40f-quorum-submit-harness.mjs --case=fixture-template-contract. The identical command and selector must become GREEN.

Using story_create_from_repro keeps the normal story lifecycle intact while adding a pre-story binding artifact. It avoids pretending candidate evidence is verificationEvidence, DONE evidence, Authority proof, or production proof.
